saw_lines: Collectors buy the character they grew up with, then chase the variant nobody else has. Scarcity closes the sale.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a collector decides if this variant is worth chasing.
Your 18 of 30 ads open on one story, so buyers see one pitch. Name two or three new angles from your own product and test each against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 29 Oct 2026
points: 18 of your 30 ads open on one story, so they fight each other for the same buyers. Test two or three new angles from your own product, like the variant pull and NHL figure, each against the current opener.
25 of your 30 ads are catalog ads with no copy of their own, so buyers see a bare title and no reason to stop. Build three image ads for your top products, each with its own opening line.
None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a first time buyer has no reason to trust you. Collect one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.
18 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the figure on screen, so the buyer must search for it. Point each ad to the product page it shows, one product page per figure.

ads_1: Fresh openers built on variant pulls and NHL figures, tested against the current story
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X and YouTube
